standards.title: Circuit Breaker Sizing
standards.rule: Breaker must be sized at 125% of continuous load. 15A for lighting, 20A for kitchen outlets.

standards.title: GFCI Protection
standards.rule: GFCI required within 6 feet of water source: kitchens, bathrooms, outdoor, garage, crawlspace

standards.title: Junction Box Required
standards.rule: All wire splices must be enclosed in an accessible junction box. No open-air splices.

standards.title: Wire Color Coding
standards.rule: Black/Red = hot, White = neutral, Green/Bare = ground. Consistent throughout installation.
standards.violation_indicator: Wrong color used, multiple hot colors mixed

standards.title: Outlet Spacing
standards.rule: No point along wall should be more than 6 feet from an outlet. Minimum 1 outlet per 12ft wall.

safety.requirement: Turn off breaker and verify with voltage tester before touching any wires
Use VDE-certified insulated screwdrivers, pliers, and cutters rated for 1000V
safety.mitigates: Shock from accidental contact with live parts

safety.requirement: Wear rubber-soled non-conductive footwear when working on electrical
safety.mitigates: Ground fault current path through body

safety.requirement: Face shield, FR clothing for panel work above 240V

tools.name: Fish Tape
tools.use: Pulling wire through conduit and walls

tools.name: Circuit Tracer
tools.use: Identifying which breaker controls which outlet
